# Issue #721 independent controls

These PDFs are hand-assembled, not generated by oxidize-pdf. Both have ordinary
xref tables with byte offsets and were checked with `qpdf --check` (exit 0).
`issue_721_valid.pdf` has a Catalog, a Pages tree and one blank page.
`issue_721_rgb_font.pdf` adds a Helvetica resource and a stream containing
`1 0 0 rg` and `BT /F1 12 Tf 50 700 Td (Control) Tj ET`.

Trailing whitespace brings each file to 1,100 bytes so issue #722's existing
minimum-size heuristic does not confound these tests. qpdf checks syntax; this
is not evidence of full ISO or PDF/A conformance. The tests invoke the public
verification API directly without requiring an external executable at runtime.
